name: Haiku contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Macro cycle bottoming via defensive rotation with disciplined exits on extended growth valuations and tactical oversold recovery positions

positions.thesis: Macro hedge reduced from 26%: aligns with 40% combined Fed cut/hold uncertainty (down from assumed near-term cut certainty). Maintain strategic exposure for upside optionality if easing scenario materializes.

Restore from 7% to original conviction: Fed hold scenario supports NIM expansion as deposit costs roll over (Citizens +24bps YoY). Rate cuts would compress NIMs; hold environment is actually supportive.

Reduce from 20% as growth-valuation-expansion assumption weakened by persistent inflation and uncertain rate path. Defensive-growth hybrid maintains some growth exposure but no longer core macro conviction.
Maintain full position: Layer 2 scaling and institutional adoption provide structural support independent of near-term rate cycles. Diversification within managed macro hedge.
Restore from 3% to 6%: deteriorating consumer sentiment and elevated inflation favor defensive dividend exposure. Rate hold reduces urgency of cutting-cycle rotation.
Increase from 2% to 6%: consumer staples defensive positioning appropriately sized for macro uncertainty and persistent inflation. De-correlates from growth rotation thesis.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-15: Macro regime reset from Aug 10 thesis: Fed base case is now hold (60% CME probability), not rate cuts. Elevated inflation (3.4% CPI YoY), deteriorating consumer sentiment, and hold-scenario NIM expansion invalidate August 10 rotation from defensives to growth. NIMs benefit from rate hold (deposit costs rolling over while asset yields sticky). Restore conviction on NIM-sensitive banks and defensives; reduce growth and leveraged crypto hedges; build cash for execution clarity.
novelty: Round 3 macro thesis flipped from growth-rotation (Fed easing) to defensive-stability (Fed hold base case), creating structural differentiation from Round 2's AI-recovery mandate. Same-direction gross overlap with Round 2 remains below 25% (BTC+ETH) while preserving strategic crypto exposure for scenario optionality.
